mappings.source_role: Provider: Definer retains through IObject; Packer stores Definer& and creates temporary Definer children; all three GLib::with overloads create/pass/return Definer values.

native.evidence: Explicit retain/adopt/sink APIs and balanced copy/move/reset semantics replace implicit IObject-derived ownership.
with<Slot> is a scoped borrow of typed implementation state with a retained owner lease; it neither constructs GTK children nor returns Definer/Packer.

mappings.coverage_limit: Foundation semantics alone do not prove callers were migrated or equivalent.

mappings.source_role: PopupWindow::create_view preset popup; gimp_editor_add_dropdown constructs button/arrow/boxes, attaches decorator, then packs returned widgets into the editor button box.

native.evidence: Native upstream editor uses ordinary GTK button-box construction; no direct surviving equivalent of gimp_editor_add_dropdown was identified in the reviewed replacement paths.
Current layer creation/properties popup owns its GtkPopover with ObjectRef::sink and packs preset/action buttons into GTK containers.

Related compact-options path owns row/button/popover/box via explicit sink and then packs through GTK. This is a concrete ownership pattern, not a proven one-to-one replacement of the removed dropdown API.

mappings.coverage_limit: Ownership replacement paths are present, but exact dropdown/preset behavior mapping and broader source-specific duties must remain separate; no feature-equivalence claim.

mappings.source_role: PopupWindowDecorator constructs label trees, generated filter argument controls, GtkAdjustments, filter selector, opacity, and clone-layer controls. Ten GLib::with calls and explicit Definer copy at line 300.

native.evidence: Tiles stores the popup in ObjectRef, closes popup connections before destroy, and constructs standard opacity/mode/lock controls in GtkPopover; clone/filter settings route to canonical layer actions.

Canonical clone/filter dialog stores one PainterLayerDialog in DialogSlot; native GTK children are parented under the dialog; Connection holds emitter refs, hooks hold weak owner plus generation, dispatch obtains a store lease, and destroy closes the store. Constructor retains input/owner leases and uses initialize then activate.

mappings.coverage_limit: Generated legacy parameter heuristics and GTK2 layout are not proven equivalent by these ownership tests; existing 29.006/proc-args-owner, menu-borrowed-reference, popover-handler-teardown, and all verification assignments remain unchanged.

mappings.source_role: LayerTileView::constructed builds action buttons, scroller, and drawing area through chained Packer; popup_layer_operation constructs menus/items through GLib::with.

native.evidence: One BindingStore Slot owns Tiles. Explicit ObjectRef fields retain model/root widget lifetimes; initial GTK children are packed/added directly. Popup uses ObjectRef::sink, Connection vectors, close-before-destroy, and widget destroy closes the store. No Packer wrapper owns a second implicit child reference.

mappings.coverage_limit: This is ownership and construction mapping only; tile geometry, selection, ordering, icon fallback, previews, and native pointer/pen parity stay with their existing tasks.

mappings.source_role: ToolTileView::constructed wraps owner with GLib::with, packs a scrolled window, and adds drawing area via Definer::add_with_viewport with event callbacks.

native.evidence: Tool controls now live within shell-owned Canvas Slot. Overlay frames use explicit ObjectRef::sink, root children use explicit retain, and GTK containers parent scrollers/boxes/buttons. Rebuild retains old children while destroying them; callbacks use weak owner/generation and leases; close disconnects sources/signals before destroying panel roots.

mappings.coverage_limit: Legacy tool group state/persistence and display behavior remain assigned separately; GTK layout redesign is not feature equivalence.
